children: Murphy USA reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $6.89 billion and net income of $176 million, with diluted EPS of $9.59. Revenue, net income and EPS increased from the prior-year quarter, while fuel contribution rose and merchandise contribution declined.
¹ Reported as “Total operating revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted Earnings Per Common Share”.
Total fuel contribution increased 24.6% to $479.4 million. Retail gallons grew 3.3%, and fuel supply and RINs also strengthened.
Merchandise sales rose 2.9%, while merchandise contribution fell 2.8%, partly because a nicotine promotion in the prior-year quarter did not repeat.
Murphy USA operated 1,808 stores across 27 states at quarter-end, compared with 1,772 stores a year earlier.
The company plans $475 million to $525 million in 2026 capital spending, including $375 million to $400 million for retail growth, and is expanding its food and beverage capabilities.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
